title: Fly over the Eden Project on the SkyWire
supports: Eden Project documents the 660-metre SkyWire above its biomes, speeds up to 60 mph, current operation, booking route and weather restrictions. The matching Viator product is ACTIVE, supplies briefing and harness fitting, lasts about one hour and has seven current or future schedule seasons.
hidden_gem_rationale: A prominent commercial activity at the Eden Project; classified as non-gem. It is a different action from Wayfinder’s existing exploration of the biomes.

title: Visit ICEHOTEL’s ice art exhibition by day
supports: ICEHOTEL’s official visitor page confirms day admission to the ice art exhibition and year-round operation. The ACTIVE three-hour Viator product includes ICEHOTEL entrance, a short guided introduction and independent exhibition time, followed by Jukkasjärvi church and a Sámi museum and reindeer stop; one current or future schedule season was verified.
hidden_gem_rationale: ICEHOTEL is an internationally known destination; classified as non-gem. A daytime art visit is a different activity from Wayfinder’s existing overnight ICEHOTEL stay.

publisher: Central Macedonia Regional Tourism and Viator
title: Canyon through the Orlias waterfalls on Mount Olympus
supports: Central Macedonia’s official Pieria guide identifies canyoning in the Orlias stream at Mount Olympus. The ACTIVE Viator product verifies a three-hour beginner-friendly descent with a briefing, short approach, supervised jumps, slides and rappels, plus technical equipment; one current or future schedule season was verified.
hidden_gem_rationale: Orlias Gorge canyoning is less prominent than the classic Olympus summit route while remaining a documented local outdoor experience; classified as a gem. It is a different route and action from Wayfinder’s Mount Olympus summit walk.

title: Kayak and snorkel beneath Cabo de Gata’s volcanic cliffs
supports: Spain’s official tourism site documents guided kayak and snorkel routes beneath Cabo de Gata’s volcanic cliffs and into coves and marine habitat. The ACTIVE Viator product includes a three-hour guided sea-kayak route, snorkel equipment, safety briefing, qualified guides and support boat; three current or future schedule seasons run from March to October.
hidden_gem_rationale: A quality active-tourism option in an established natural park; classified as non-gem. It is a different action and water route from Wayfinder’s existing volcanic-coast walk.

title: Cross the Bardenas Reales badlands by guided 4x4
supports: Navarre’s official tourism site lists guided 4x4 routes through the Bardenas Reales throughout 2026. The ACTIVE Viator product is a three-hour private guided route through the Bardena Blanca with stops at formations including Castildetierra, short desert walks and interpretation; one current or future schedule season was verified.
hidden_gem_rationale: Guided 4x4 touring is an established way to visit the well-known Bardenas landscape; classified as non-gem. It is a different transport mode and activity from Wayfinder’s existing cycling adventure.

title: Climb the forest rope courses above Wörthersee
supports: Wörthersee Tourism documents five graded tree courses, about 40 exercises, platforms up to 20 metres and multiple flying-fox lines at Pyramidenkogel. The ACTIVE two-hour Viator product includes training and rental equipment for the forest rope park; one current or future schedule season was verified, with dates and weather requiring a current check.
hidden_gem_rationale: A locally bookable forest activity that is less prominent than Wörthersee’s swimming and boating experiences; classified as a gem. It is a separate site and action from Wayfinder’s existing lake swim.
